memory_update.text: LEU should remain in the underfollowed lane for the nuclear fuel-cycle node because the key chokepoint is domestic enrichment/HALEU scale-up, not reactor ownership.
BWXT is a reference-quality nuclear fuel/components benchmark with strong direct evidence, but its market attention and size make it less suitable as the main underfollowed discovery candidate.
CW maps to the SMR component chokepoint through X-energy NSSS subsystems, especially helium circulation, fuel handling, and safe-shutdown systems.
FLS nuclear exposure needs revenue materiality verification; current evidence supports qualification and product relevance, not yet financial significance.

summary: Expanded the nuclear fuel-cycle and qualified-components universe using a two-lane Serenity funnel. The obvious context lane includes BWXT as a scaled nuclear fuel/components reference. The underfollowed lane highlights Centrus as a direct HALEU/enrichment scarcity play, Curtiss-Wright as a critical SMR systems supplier, and Flowserve as a nuclear-qualified pumps/valves/seals supplier that may be overlooked because it screens as a broad industrial flow-control company rather than a nuclear bottleneck name.
